title: Draft tier-aware release summaries with embedded technical notes and ops briefing
creator: Priya Shah
description:
Objective: Produce a set of release artifacts that serve multiple audiences from a single source of truth: 1) short customer-facing changelogs per tier (Free/Pro/Enterprise), 2) an internal ops-ready briefing with technical notes for Support/CS/Oncall, and 3) an embedded technical appendix for engineers who will validate rollouts.

Scope: Includes the up-next release (console-2026.03) and a template to reuse for future releases. We will provide:
- Tiered customer changelog blurb (one-sentence summary + impact bullet) per feature.
- A short technical note per feature (compatibility, required migrations, known regressions, feature flags).
- Ops checklist (rollout steps, verification queries, rollback criteria, alert links).
- One consolidated Confluence page and a markdown asset for the console “Release Notes” UI.

Success criteria:
- Stakeholders (Support, Sales/CS, Engineering, Design, Security) sign off on the draft by 2026-03-16.
- Changelog content is populated and locked 48 hours before release cut.
- Measurement: fewer than 3 high-severity tickets in first 72 hours attributable to documentation gaps.

Trade-offs/decisions:
- Level of detail: Decide between a single canonical changelog entry with layered excerpts versus maintaining separate documents per audience. We are proceeding with a single canonical source and derived excerpts to reduce drift.
- Embedding technical notes into the customer-facing console will require truncation and a "View technical details" link—ensures compliance with public-facing simplicity while preserving engineer context.

Stakeholders: Support (Leads: Hannah Park), CS (Leads: Ravi Patel), Engineering (NA: Runtime, Leads: Alex Chen), Design (Lead: Sofia Alvarez), Security (Lead: Carla Mendez).

Deliverables and timeline:
- 2026-03-05: Ticket created and kickoff meeting scheduled.
- 2026-03-06: Initial content template drafted (Confluence) and shared.
- 2026-03-09: Feature owners provide first-pass technical notes.
- 2026-03-11: Draft customer excerpts for Free/Pro/Enterprise produced.
- 2026-03-13: Legal & Security quick scan completed; redaction guidance applied.
- 2026-03-16: Target stakeholder sign-off.
- 2026-03-18: Final content locked for release.

Acceptance criteria:
- All feature entries include a one-line customer blurb, a short technical note (1-3 bullets), and a validation metric or smoke-test query.
- Confluence page and console markdown are identical sources (automated sync step tracked with ENG-9023).

Risks:
- Late API contract changes could invalidate technical notes; mitigation: freeze technical notes 72h before release and schedule an engineering change window.
- Overly technical customer wording could confuse Free users; mitigation: maintain separate one-line blurbs per tier.

Notes:
- We will push a single PR that updates the console markdown and triggers the in-app banner. PR link below.
- Keep an audit trail of redactions per Security review for compliance audits.
